data.description:
Experience DJing like never before! Completely reimagined for Meta Quest, the award-winning djay app redefines the art of DJing, bringing your favorite music to life. Whether you’re a seasoned DJ or just starting out, djay empowers you to mix tracks on lifelike 3D turntables, control effects with intuitive hand gestures, and immerse yourself in environments that react dynamically to your music.

From the energy of a packed club to the atmosphere of an arena with thousands of fans, every mix feels truly unforgettable. Get ready to mix, create, explore, and become your own DJ!


# Top Features

- Extensive Music Library: Access a vast library of 5000+ free songs, 100+ million songs via streaming services Apple Music, TIDAL, SoundCloud, Beatport, and Beatsource, or music stored locally on your device.
- Mixed Reality & Immersive Environments: Dive into immersive settings like Club, Lounge, Arena, Balloon, Skatepark, Volcano, and Space.
- Audio-Reactive Surroundings: Experience dynamic visuals and light shows that react to your performance in real-time.
- Intuitive Control: Use hand gestures for seamless interaction.
- Spatial Effects: Move your hands freely in 3D space to control multiple audio effects simultaneously. 
- MIDI Integration: Plug-and-play support for a wide range of DJ controllers and multi-channel audio interfaces.
- World-Class Audio Engine: High-quality time-stretching, beat and tempo detection, and low latency for professional-grade sound.

changelog.change_log:
Thank you for using djay! We update the app regularly to provide the best mixing experience for you. Here is what’s new in this release:
	
GENERAL

• Added plug-and-play USB integration for the all-new AlphaTheta DDJ-FLX2 controller
• Improved music streaming service integrations (Apple Music, TIDAL, SoundCloud, Beatport, Beatsource)
• Enhanced free music with dozens of new tracks
• Improved introductory tutorial
• Added setting for toggling Crossfade FX
• Added setting for crossfader curve type
• Added setting to lock the turntable grab handle to always ensure a fixed position during performance

FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS

• Fixed potential issue where music streaming logins might need to be re-entered upon subsequent app launches
• Fixed missing artwork when playing files from local storage
• Fixed sound issues when using Bluetooth headphones
• Fixed changes to quantize cue points not being saved

MIDI / DJ CONTROLLER IMPROVEMENTS

• Improved DJ controller cutout in virtual environments
• Added possibility to turn off sync when using DJ controllers
• Fixed potential sound issues with DJ controllers on Quest 2
• Fixed potential sound issues when unplugging a DJ controller
• Fixed scratch delay with Reloop Buddy when routing audio through audio interface

If you enjoy the app, please support us by rating it on the Meta Horizon Store. We appreciate your feedback!
